svg: Architecture patterns that earn enterprise trust1 Data residency & isolationAI runs inside the customer boundary.No external calls with their data.2 Encryption everywhereAES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit,field-level PII, customer keys (BYOK).3 Permission inheritanceAgents inherit user RBAC (row/column).No god-mode. Least privilege.4 Multi-tenant isolationDB-level tenant separation; sanitizebefore every model call (pen-tested).5 Comprehensive loggingImmutable 6-W audit trail;7-year retention for regulators.6 Explainable AIChain-of-thought, citations, 0–100%confidence, “Why?” per decision.7 Reliability by designValidation + confidence routing:>90 auto / 70–90 human / <70 escalate.
